proposals.evidence: Turner’s *trāgga/*tārga/*tāgra article explicitly has Punjabi tāgā/taggā “thread”, also Hindi, Bengali and Nepali tāgā, continuing Prakrit tagga. Pothwari tāɣā preserves the whole word with intervocalic g lenited to ɣ. The reconstruction alternatives remain alternatives within the chosen dictionary family; aspirated thāgā forms are excluded pending comparison with *dhāgga.
